messages.text:
Help me choose: explain the remaining questions in plain language. Keep my original task and the details I already provided.
My answers so far:
Plan name: Vector Teams
Description: An AI workspace for growing teams. Includes 15 seats, unlimited projects, 35,000 monthly AI credits, and priority support.
Price: 99
Currency: USD

Choose billing and trial terms
Billing period controls how often customers pay: monthly is easier to start and cancel; yearly gives a longer commitment and charges $99 once per year. A free trial lets customers try the plan before being charged; no trial charges immediately. A paid trial charges a smaller trial fee, which you’dʻ‍
Billing period Choices: Monthly; Yearly.
Trial Choices: No trial; Free trial; Paid trial.

questions.description: How often should the $99 subscription renew?

options.label: Monthly
options.description: Charge $99 each month; lower commitment for customers.

options.label: Yearly
options.description: Charge $99 each year; lower annual revenue at this price.

questions.label: Trial
questions.description: Should customers get trial access before the regular subscription begins?

options.label: Free trial
options.description: Access starts free, then $99 is charged after a chosen number of days.

options.label: Paid trial
options.description: Charge a separate trial fee before the regular $99 subscription.

messages.text:
Details for Choose billing and trial terms:
Billing period: Monthly
Trial: 14-day free trial
Vector Teams is saved as an active test subscription at $99.00 monthly with a free 14-day trial.
Actually, give teams 21 days to try it. Keep everything else the same.
Vector Teams now has a 21-day free trial; its $99.00 monthly price and other plan details remain unchanged.
Now create a launch offer for that plan only: 20% off once, code TEAMSTART20, name Teams Welcome, 50 uses, no expiry.
Teams Welcome is saved as an active test discount for Vector Teams only: code TEAMSTART20, 20% off once, capped at 50 uses, with no expiry.
What will the first paid invoice be before tax?
The first paid invoice will be $79.20 before tax, after the one-time 20% discount on $99.
Does that change Starter or Pro?
No. Teams Welcome applies only to Vector Teams, so Starter and Pro are unchanged.
Show me Home and summarize the current activity.

Home shows Test mode activity for the last 30 days: 1 customer, 1 sale, $49.00 average order, $49.00 MRR, and $49.00 gross revenue. The latest sandbox payment is a paid $49.00 monthly Vector Pro subscription, and India accounts for the one customer.
